title: Bulgaria celebrates its Roma champions. But only political representation will make it a true democracy
snippet: The position of Roma in regional societies remains one of stratification. While successful Roma are often celebrated by national governments, the wider community still suffers from marginalization. Roma political representation of all kinds can play a key part in overcoming this issue. Artykuł Bulgaria celebrates its Roma champions.
